title: Wheel Throwing Classes
source_quote: Wheel Throwing Learn to center, pull, and shape clay on the wheel. Six-week sessions with small groups and individual guidance.
evidence_sentence: The studio homepage states wheel throwing classes are offered and fire work in cone 6 electric kilns.
evidence_quote: High-fire stoneware, cone 6 electric, food-safe and built to last.
summary: Six-week wheel-throwing classes for all levels; work fires in the studio's electric kilns. Classes cap at 12 students.
how_to_join: Join the waitlist on the studio website for early access and founding rates.
